destination.name: Copper Coast
destination.tagline: Cornish copper towns and jetty beaches on the northern Yorke Peninsula coast.
destination.description: The Copper Coast is the northern Yorke Peninsula around Kadina, Wallaroo and Moonta, where Cornish miners worked copper from the 1860s. Moonta Mines is a state heritage area with a museum, tourist railway and walking trails, and Kadina's Farm Shed Museum holds the stump-jump plough. Wallaroo has a heritage and nautical museum and North Beach, while Moonta Bay and Port Hughes add jetties and swimming beaches. A sealed rail trail links Kadina, Wallaroo and Moonta.
whyVisit: Swim and fish off jetty beaches
Cycle the sealed coastal rail trail

goodToKnow.title: Check museum hours
goodToKnow.detail: Wallaroo's museum is shut most Mondays and Moonta's has set afternoon hours, so check times before you drive.

goodToKnow.title: Cycle in sections
goodToKnow.detail: The sealed 25 km rail trail runs Kadina to Moonta via Wallaroo, so ride one stretch and drive back.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: {months} are the warm months for beach days and jetty swims at Moonta Bay and Wallaroo.
